problem_statement: The IP address parser can overflow an internal buffer when parsing an address string that includes a port number. This occurs when the provided string length is larger than the actual content, or when the port string is overly long (more than 5 characters). The parser should safely handle these cases by bounding the port string copy to a fixed-size buffer and rejecting port strings that exceed the maximum valid length.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/utils -s tests/net/utils/net.util.asan -s net.util.asan -O twister-out --no-clean -W
